净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Simplified drawdown/ATR factor by removing the SMA smoothing and shortening ATR window from 14 to 10 to increase responsiveness and potentially improve IC, while preserving the core regime-adaptive trailing high mechanism for drawdown calculation. Cross-sectional rank ensures cross-stock comparability.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

drawdown = (regime_adaptive_trailing_high(40/60) - close) / regime_adaptive_trailing_high; atr = ts_atr(10); raw = drawdown / atr
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume, style_gate_resvol_high

  1. 1. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)

  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), AdjClose), where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), AdjClose)

  10. 10. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)

算子/字段含义

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high：high
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 close：close
  4. 计算 resvol_high：style_gate_resvol_high > 0
  5. 计算 max_high_highvol：high.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=20).max()
  6. 计算 max_high_lowvol：high.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=20).max()
  7. 计算 max_high：np.where(resvol_high, max_high_highvol, max_high_lowvol)
  8. 计算 drawdown：(max_high - close) / max_high
  9. 计算 drawdown：drawdown
  10. 计算 atr：talib.ATR(high.values.astype(np.float64)
  11. 计算 timeperiod：10)
  12. 计算 atr_series：pd.Series(atr, index=df_copy.index)
  13. 计算 factor：drawdown / atr_series
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10(df): df_copy = df.copy() high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] close = df_copy["str">'close'] resvol_high = df_copy["str">'style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0 max_high_highvol = high.rolling(40, min_periods=20).max() max_high_lowvol = high.rolling(60, min_periods=20).max() max_high = np.where(resvol_high, max_high_highvol, max_high_lowvol) drawdown = (max_high - close) / max_high drawdown = drawdown.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) atr = talib.ATR(high.values.astype(np.float64), low.values.astype(np.float64), close.values.astype(np.float64), timeperiod=10) atr_series = pd.Series(atr, index=df_copy.index) factor = drawdown / atr_series.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10']
